description: ST. PAUL, MN – The Minnesota Department of Transportation (MnDOT) this week announced expansion and improvement work for the 39-mile section of I-94 between Maple Grove and Clearwater will begin this summer.“This is fantastic news for our community,” Lucero said. “Roads and bridges transportation funding has been one of the top priorities I’ve been fighting for during my time in office and improvements to I-94 will reduce congestion for tens of thousands of hardworking people.”Work to be perform
